author: Camemes
body:
Hey, I recently disbanded my clan (of 2) and am now actively seeking a team to join.

A few things about me:
- Hell good with a bow and arrow
- Has skype (sheamusplaysmc) Teamspeak and email (drfrankensheamus@gmail.com) as well as a rather obscure YouTube channel (https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC2v42hHP6ARf8Tz-YysjhiQ)
- Average at PvP
- Preferable positon = Midfield or rusher
- Only able to play like 1 hour during the week but play 80% on weekends
- Great time management
- Dedicated
- References
     - SuperJoey631 - https://avicus.net/SuperJoey631 (active user)
     - CozzehPvP_ - https://avicus.net/CozzehPvP_ (non-active user)

Stats:
- 6,674 kills
- 9,530 Deaths (kind of a risk taker)
- 11 days worth of time on the server
- 0.7 KD ratio
- 0.77 PvP KD ratio
